stem: A 50/50 test has 502,000 users in control and 498,000 in treatment, a 50.2% share. The threshold for a sample ratio mismatch is p < 0.001, a chi-square critical value of 10.83 with 1 degree of freedom. What does this split tell you?

options.text: It is within one point of 50%, so it is fine whatever the number of users
At this size it is more than chance allows, so look for the cause
It is fine as long as the conversion rates are compared for buyers only
It can be fixed by reweighting both groups back to exactly 50% each
